title: Does It Matter *When* You Apply to a Job?
description:
Does it matter WHEN you apply to a job? Yes…but also no. Properly showcasing your qualifications and taking that time to update your resume is always worth it and applying to a job that’s been open for a month is always always worth it if it’s something you like. When it comes to timing, the thing to be aware of is if you are applying after it’s been open for a while there might be someone who is the company like who is just further along in the process. That doesn’t mean you aren’t qualified or the company won’t look at your application, but it might mean they have already found someone who move forward with. #jobapplication #jobapplicationtips #jobapplications #application #jobseeker #jobseekertips
